text: As the BRIEF.md addendum '2026-10-16: Gaps audit and refine the planning pipeline' asks: have the logged gaps (interventions, introspections, rejections, independent ratings) audit the planning pipeline. Trace each gap to the planning stage that missed it (reading, decomposition, assumptions, criteria, outcome check) and refine that stage, so the next plan cannot make the same miss. Athena does this itself, as a role, and checks whether its refinements reduced later gaps of the same kind.
